WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  telescope_count,
  telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS telescope_count_ratio
FROM station_stats
ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
